how: Watched a tape carrying NO model output, so these are a record of the game rather than a reaction to what the pipeline claimed. the note: 'times are rough estimates: recorded times are either right before the shot, as ball is in air, or right after it hits, but they all correspond to shots.'
why_it_matters: Before this the project had 7 shots of continuous ground truth across two windows, which is why two rules in a row scored well on one minute and collapsed on the next. This is 20, with hoop, outcome and shooter on every one.
caution_on_attribution: The shooters run in a STRICT rotation, so a model that simply follows the order pink-white-blue scores 100% without reading a single cap. Attribution has to be reported against that baseline, not against a 33% coin flip.

shots.note: behind the back and airball, short of the basket; judged: could be considered a pass under some circumstances

not_shots.note: players line up in a row before the next set. A per-party cap reference, filmed without anyone planning it as one.

conditions.note: defenders now have hands up instead of at sides

names_removed: Shooters recorded by CAP COLOR, not name. The repo is public and the pipeline only ever uses the cap; the name mapping is a local detail and is not needed to score anything.
